{{Quote|Sergeant Jung, dead. Blast it. I'll put her in for a commendation along with her men.|[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Tso]]|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Era Jung''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. By [[3637 BBY]] she served in the [[Viridian Squad]] under [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Tso]], who said on several occasions that a girl from a rich family like Jung was unfit to lead his men. On [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] Jung led the Viridian Squad on a reconnaissance mission to the [[Temple of Sacrifice]], but they were ambushed by the local savage [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]]. Most the team got killed, the few survivors taken captives. Jung was wounded, but attempted a rescue mission, which failed led to her death. Before dying, she left a final report for Major Tso; the report was found on her [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] by a member of the Coalition, who completed the mission and rescued her men. Upon hearing the news, Major Tso proclaimed the Viridian Squad as heroes and promised to put them all - including Era Jung - for a commendation.<ref name="SWTOR" />
